# Test Engineer

Use the [test-engineer](../agents/test-engineer.md) persona and the [test-driven-development](../skills/test-driven-development/SKILL.md) skill.

Analyze coverage gaps, write or propose the right tests, and keep the focus on behavior rather than implementation details.
